paragraphs.text: A Serpent Generator is a magical artifact that can be used to create large amounts of artificial poison snakes .

The Serpent Generator is an artifact used to create large amounts of artificial snakes. It can create a variety of species, including garter and rattlesnakes, depending on the spices used as fuel. A red liquid is placed into the generator, and then poison snakes are produced out of it. The snakes appear to be a golden or green color with green eyes and large fangs.

One was used by Ramses Overdark to stop the rebellion of the Edemi Islands ; two others were found by Strother, Borg and Elam , a trio of not-too-bright mercenaries known as the Ugly Triumvirate. Their stories can be found in the books The Dragons of Magic and The Monsters of Magic .
A serpent generator was found by students of Greensleeves around 4073 AR .
